failureLimitBasis.appealModel: A wrongful FINAL(FAIL) against an honest seller needs two independently drawn verifiers to err. A single verifier errs either because it is non-honest and colludes against this seller, with probability c * (1 - h), or because it is honest and the predicate falsely rejects, with probability h * alpha; w1 = c * (1 - h) + h * alpha, an upper bound only for c >= alpha (a non-honest verifier that does not collude still errs at alpha), so c is taken as max(c, alpha). Paths to a wrongful confirmed failure, per judged case: an initial FAIL appealed by the seller (every FAIL is assumed appealed) and confirmed by the party-review verifier, drawn independently of and excluding the first (w1^2); the same initial FAIL overturned by the party review and confirmed by the tiebreak it leads to (ADR 0019), w1 * (1 - w1) * w1 <= w1^2; an initial PASS appealed by an adversarial buyer with probability b_a (buyerAppealsEveryPass: b_a = 1), flipped by the party review and confirmed by the tiebreak, whose error is bounded by one after the flip (b_a * w1^2); an unappealed initial PASS rechecked with probability s_re = recheckPpm / PPM, flipped and confirmed by the tiebreak ((1 - b_a) * s_re * w1^2). Per judged case u = w1^2 * (2 + b_a + (1 - b_a) * s_re) = 3 * w1^2 at b_a = 1 (ADR 0021 corrects ADR 0019, which omitted the second path and used u = 2 * w1^2). Each settlement is judged with probability pi = samplePpm / PPM, so per settlement q = pi * u. The settlements that can produce a confirmed failure inside one fixed failure window of W blocks are those settled in [w - caseHorizon, w + W] (settlementBasis), bounded by S = ceil(bucketCapacity + refillPpmPerBlock * (W + caseHorizon) / PPM) at scale factor one; a window opened at scale factor n sanctions at n * failureLimit (ADR 0021), so the bound holds per unit of scale. c is the share of non-honest verifier weight that votes against an honest seller; c = 1 is the worst case in which all non-honest weight colludes. The detection ceiling does not use c: it still assumes all non-honest weight colludes with a cheating seller.
failureLimitBasis.annualTerminalSanctionProbability: at most 1.447e-04 per year at scaleFactor 1 (262.8 windows of 60000 blocks per year of two-second blocks times the per-window bound; 1.953e-05 with the exact binomial tail); a bond account at scale factor n has n * failureLimit per window (ADR 0021); derived from assumed c, h, alpha, s_re and b_a = 1, not measured
failureLimitBasis.derivation: w1 = 0.1 * (1 - 0.67) + 0.67 * 0.01 = 0.033 + 0.0067 = 0.039700 (c = 0.1 >= alpha); s_re = recheckPpm / PPM = 0.2; b_a = 1; u = w1^2 * (2 + b_a + (1 - b_a) * s_re) = 3 * w1^2 = 0.00472827 (ceiling 4729 ppm; ADR 0019 had 2 * w1^2 = 0.003152, which missed the initial FAIL overturned on appeal and confirmed by the tiebreak); pi = samplePpm / PPM = 0.1; q = pi * u = 0.000472827. Settlements that can be confirmed failed inside one failure window of W = 60000 blocks are those settled in [w - caseHorizon, w + W] with caseHorizon = 31073: S = ceil(20 + 0.05 * (60000 + 31073)) = 4574 (about 458 judged cases; expected wrongful final failures S * q = 2.163). failureLimit k is the least k with C(S, k) * q^k <= 1e-6: k = 14, C(4574, 14) * q^14 = 5.507e-07 (exact binomial tail P[X >= 14] = 7.430e-08). The least k whose exact binomial tail is at most 1e-6 is 13, so the union bound costs 1 extra step(s) at these values. This limit is computed for scale factor one; a bond account with scaleFactor n settles up to n times as many purchases, and a failure window that opens at scale n sanctions at n * failureLimit and deducts n * sellerPenalty in all (ADR 0021). Buyer-opened disputes are not counted in S. c = 0.1 is a stated assumption, not a measurement; profile-v1.md section 4 tabulates failureLimit for c from 0 to 1, and at c = 1 the limit is 414; with b_a = 0 (no adversarial buyer appeals) it is 12. Each wrongful final failure still suspends the seller, freezes its bond account and deducts sellerPenalty / failureLimit from the bond (ADR 0013, ADR 0018); the seller may re-enter during the claim window after topping the share up (ADR 0021).

analysis.notes: Functional defaults only. Effective probability is an unvalidated design input, not a measured or established history-conditional lower bound; reserved-capital exclusions and keeper delays remain to be calibrated. maxInconclusivePpm is a placeholder until natural inconclusive rates are measured; minJudgedCount = 30 is a placeholder of about 6 / theta at theta = maxInconclusivePpm / PPM = 0.2, so the first sampled inconclusives of a window cannot freeze the account on their own (ADR 0020). freezeOnInitialFail = false: the freeze, the suspension and the claim window all start at the confirmed failure; only the admission-override test build admits true, and requires it when retentionBlocks < caseHorizon. beaconDelayBlocks is the settlement-chain block equivalent of a 128 L1 block beacon delay. Derivation (appealBlocks = 1800, ADR 0024): openHorizon = max(1868, 1860, min(1868, 1860) + 3*300) = 2760 (see section 3; the last term is a sample case opened after a buyer non-delivery dispute ended as delivered); judgmentDelayBlocks L = 2760 + 3*3*(2*600 + 3*300) + 3*(1800 + 300) + 1800 + 3*(3-1) + 2*(2*200 + 3) + 1 = 30573 (every stage with all its assignments and serve procedures, two lapsed review seals, and the block in which a stalled seller-appealed review upholds the initial FAIL); caseHorizon = L + marginBlocks = 30573 + 500 = 31073; retentionBlocks = deferBlocks = claimWindowBlocks = failureWindowBlocks = inconclusiveWindowBlocks = 60000 (kept; the keeper margin retentionBlocks - caseHorizon is now 28927 blocks); enforcementBlocks = 31073 >= L. samplePpm = 100000 (pi = 0.1 for every class). h = 0.67 (assumedHonestWeightPpm) is an assumption, not a measured value; it is used for both the detection ceiling and failureLimitBasis. The collusion share c = 0.1 (failureLimitBasis.convictionCollusionPpm) is also an assumption and enters only failureLimit, not the detection ceiling. failureLimit is derived in failureLimitBasis.derivation.
